title: Department of War releases UFO files on Trump's order

tellings.quote: On May 8th, 2026, [music] the Department of War released hundreds of UFO-related documents, video, and audio with President Trump ordering the release of government files related to ET life and UFOs,
We're at an unprecedented time in UFO history where the president is actively contemplating releasing documents, which they clearly have, on on these unidentified flying objects.
tellings.difference: Says the president is still thinking about releasing the documents, where the story says the Department of War released them on May 8, 2026.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about President Trump releasing government UFO files in 2026.

as_told.title: Department of War releases UFO documents on a website

plain: On May 8, 2026, Michels says, the Department of War released hundreds of UFO-related documents, videos and audio recordings, after President Trump ordered the release of government files on alien life and UFOs. In an earlier episode he explains how it started: Trump announced on Truth Social, his social media platform, that he was directing the Pentagon and other agencies to find and release files on aliens and UAP, the official term for unidentified anomalous phenomena. Congressman Eric Burlison, speaking as an official, says the first batch was mostly videos from MQ-9 Predator military drones that had caught something that "seems really strange", and credits the White House aide Stephen Miller. The skeptic Michael Shermer says there have now been three releases and that the photos and videos all carry "big blacked out rectangles". A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet calls them the PURSUE files, says they are "still a work in progress" with no metadata, but holds that they show "a whole lot of UAP activity". The tellers differ in places: in one June episode Michels speaks as if the president were still contemplating a release, and in another he says the documents sit on a dedicated Department of War website with 500 million hits. If the files are what the tellers think, the US government has begun opening its UFO records on a president's order.
